name: Milly Osworth
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Deputy Willem sends you to help Milly Osworth. Her wagon and livelihood are in jeopardy, and she needs help across the abbey grounds. The work takes you from defending the abbey to aiding Elwynn Forest's civilians.

sections.title: A Dependable Pair of Hands
sections.body: After you prove your mettle against the Defias thieves encroaching on Northshire Valley, Deputy Willem recognizes you as capable and willing to help. He sends you to assist his friend Milly Osworth. This favor is personal, outside the abbey's official guard duties, and Milly is a civilian caught in the valley's growing unrest.

sections.title: Trouble by the Stables
sections.body: Milly waits beside her wagon on the far side of Northshire Abbey, near the stables. Deputy Willem must stay at his post to defend the abbey. Milly's troubles lie out in the valley, where the stretched guard garrison has too few hands to help her.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Milly Osworth?
aliases: where to get milly osworth quest
faq.answer: Deputy Willem sends you to speak with Milly after you prove reliable by dealing with the Defias bandits.

faq.q: Where can Milly Osworth be found?
faq.answer: Milly waits beside her wagon on the far side of Northshire Abbey, near the stables and the vineyards to the southeast.

faq.q: Why can't Deputy Willem help Milly himself?
faq.answer: Willem's guard duties keep him at Northshire Abbey. With bandits and vermin pressing the valley, the garrison has too few hands for private civilian troubles.

faq.q: What prerequisites are needed for this quest?
aliases: how to unlock milly osworth quest
faq.answer: You need to complete Brotherhood of Thieves for Deputy Willem before he trusts you to help Milly.

faq.q: What does Milly need help with?
faq.answer: Milly is struggling with her crop and wagon amid the local turmoil. Her harvest needs securing from the surrounding valley.

faq.q: Who is Milly Osworth to Deputy Willem?
faq.answer: Willem calls Milly a friend in need from the Northshire community, someone he looks out for while bound to his post.

angles.text: In Northshire, you see how stretched Alliance guards rely on passing adventurers to protect local townspeople from emerging threats.
As a young human in Northshire, you can help Willem and show the community spirit that helps hold Elwynn together.
